# `Q-12-1` — Custom Listing Template Not Yet Supported

> A listing configuration value is unrecognized or in a shape the
> parser does not yet handle.

## What this means

The `listing:` key in a document's front matter (or under
`website.listing:` in `_quarto.yml`) accepts several shapes: a
boolean, a type-name string (`default`, `grid`, `table`,
`custom`, `metadata`), an object with a richer set of fields, or an array of
such objects. This error fires when the value does not match any
of those shapes, or when an inner field (such as `field-types`)
uses a name the parser does not recognize.

The listing falls back to the `default` type so the rest of the
document still renders, but the unrecognized configuration is
ignored.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **Misspelled type name.** Writing `type: gird` instead of
  `type: grid`.
- **A field whose value is the wrong shape.** For example,
  `field-types:` whose entries are not one of `date`, `string`,
  `number`, `minutes`.
- **A configuration form Quarto does not yet support.** Some
  Quarto 1 listing options are not yet implemented in Quarto 2.

## How to fix

Check the type name and the inner field values against the
[listing reference](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html).
If you are migrating from Quarto 1, expect a small number of
options to land later in Quarto 2 — confirm the option is
supported before using it.

## Related

  `type: custom`.
